title: Light Malaysian Chicken Pilaf
description: A rich and comforting Malaysian dish featuring yellow masarepa and Mediterranean-friendly flavors, made with chicken and a blend of spices, this pilaf is a perfect meal for any time of day.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken to the saucepan and cook until it is browned on all sides and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Add the yellow masarepa to the saucepan and stir to combine, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken broth to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the masarepa is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
